title: LLMEval-Med: A Real-world Clinical Benchmark for Medical LLMs with Physician Validation
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure any aspects of faith or religion. Its focus was on evaluating medical large language models in five core areas: Medical Knowledge, Medical Language Understanding, Medical Reasoning, Medical Text Generation, and Medical Safety and Ethics.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its scope is limited to the medical domain.
